authentication: n/a - there is no public register to authenticate against
entity_identifiers: UNKNOWN - there is no public register to carry a UK device identifier
historical_coverage: no public product register exists: MHRA registration is an obligation on the manufacturer and is not published as a searchable product listing
known_limitations: GOV.UK search (filtered to MHRA) returns manufacturer guidance such as 'Register medical devices to place on the market', not a register of licensed products
the UK therefore has no searchable public device register equivalent to MDALL, EUDAMED or GUDID, so no product-level UK regulatory dataset can be collected
this is a structural absence, not a technical block: no amount of retrying would produce data
licence: UNKNOWN - no dataset exists to license
research_value: Documented explicitly as a null result so no future pass wastes effort: the UK contributes no product-level regulatory rows, which means UK market entry cannot be dated from an official register and must be inferred from other evidence (or omitted).
